detailed_description:
Ava is rendered with the same premium semi-realistic 3D stylization as <Picture 1>: her controlled eye-to-face proportions, refined nose and jaw, layered dark hair, damp skin highlights, and soft gray knit loungewear remain consistent in every frame. The apartment and holographic interfaces share the same physically based lighting, clear contact shadows, and cinematic three-dimensional presentation as <Picture 2> and <Picture 3>.

[Shot 1] A high overhead view looks down at the right-side work desk in <Subject 2>. <Subject 1> finishes the last of several consecutive calls and lowers <Subject 4> onto the desk. The phone screen stays on the dark call-contact page, showing the recent records grouped around "卖车", "仓库", and "物资", with the visible "卖车仓库物资" entry matching <Picture 4>. Beside it, <Subject 3> hovers in translucent blue light; its wireframe first-level emergency floating platform rotates almost imperceptibly while the "30m³仓储" module gives quiet, regular flashes. The camera slowly pulls back from directly above the phone and blueprint, revealing the wood desktop, soft window reflections, and the calm city beyond the apartment windows. A light tap sounds as the phone meets the desk, followed by several restrained message chimes and steady distant traffic.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the shot becomes a close view as Ava lifts her eyes toward the holographic countdown. The camera pushes in smoothly until Ava and the lower-right countdown share the frame. The numbers decrease silently from "风暴倒计时 71:58:41", while the interface displays the clear screen text "【距离第一轮极端风暴：71:58:41】". Blue holographic light moves across her focused face and gray collar without changing her identity or clothing. A soft countdown pulse is audible beneath her controlled breathing; the room otherwise remains still.

[Shot 3] At 00:05.000, a fixed symmetric medium shot frames Ava at the desk with the city window centered behind her. She closes the vehicle information folder, then aligns the call records, map-location page, and supply checklist into one neat row. Her motions are economical and decisive, and her expression becomes calm and resolved without hesitation. The pages settle together, and she places a pen on the desk with one crisp click. The hologram continues glowing at the edge of the composition, while the apartment remains lit by the same overcast daylight.

[Shot 4] At 00:07.000, the camera begins a final slow push into a close facial shot. Ava first looks through the window at the city still functioning normally, then shifts her gaze back to the holographic countdown. Her hair and loose fabric shift only slightly with the small turn of her head. As the city noise gradually recedes under the push-in, <Subject 1> (S1) says:
<d>[Chinese] 这一次，我不等世界告诉我该逃了.</d>
Her mouth moves naturally with the line, delivered softly but firmly. After the final word, she holds still for half a beat, and the distant traffic becomes nearly silent.

[Shot 5] At 00:12.500, the framing closes tightly on Ava’s eyes as she looks unwaveringly at the holographic countdown. The image then cuts hard to black. For an instant, only the faint blue electronic pulse pattern belonging to <Subject 3> flickers across the darkness. One clear electronic pulse sounds, after which the scene becomes completely silent.

overall_soundscape:
The sound design is restrained and cinematic. The opening desk action carries a soft phone placement, consecutive message alerts, paper movement, and calm traffic from beyond the windows. The hologram produces subtle periodic pulses, while Ava’s breathing remains controlled in the close shots. Paper closes and the pen makes one sharp, precise desk sound. During her final line, the city bedrock noise lowers steadily until only her voice and the following half-beat of quiet remain. The sequence ends with a single clear electronic pulse and then total silence.

non_diegetic_music:
No non-diegetic musical score is introduced during the sequence. Emotional tension is carried by Ava’s performance, the quiet apartment ambience, the holographic pulses, and the receding city sound. The final electronic pulse is an interface sound effect rather than music.

medias.name: 艾娃公寓
medias.describe: 现代高层一居室公寓，开放式起居与睡眠区，整体为简约冷调的都市风格。入口侧设简洁玄关与窄柜，室内摆放双人床、书桌、沙发和低矮电视柜；整面落地大窗是构图中心，窗外可见密集楼群与正常车流，清晨暖光与白天自然光均可洒入。浅灰墙面、木纹地板与雾蓝软装形成干净克制的层次，电视正在滚动新闻，房间整洁但透着灾变前短暂平静的紧迫感。

medias.name: 清晨便服
medias.describe: 继承五官识别点。深棕长发散披未扎马尾，穿浅灰棉质圆领家居睡衣与同色长裤、赤足，面带惊惶冷汗；清晨窗光侧照。仅用于灾变前72小时公寓惊醒场，与工装默认态互斥。

medias.name: 重启蓝图
medias.describe: 相对默认全息界面：清晨公寓中展开完整冷蓝面板，显示核心07已重启、30m³仓储、一级应急浮台线框蓝图、风暴倒计时71:58:41。现世苏醒后启用，与回溯提示框态互斥。

medias.name: 通话联络页
medias.describe: 手机停在通话与联系人界面，通话计时、卖车仓库物资等联络记录可辨，界面冷峻；艾娃连续拨打电话时使用。与日期、银行、地图页互斥。
